# #472 Rapportvinnarna, rapportförlorarna och fallande knivar

**Feed**: avanzapodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Avanza-podden reviews a Q3 report season where solid or in-line results are not enough. Large industrials such as ABB, Atlas Copco and Lifco fell on their reports, while consumer small caps such as Nelly, Humble, Bone Support, Lyko, Kjell and BHG rallied. Volvo Cars and Intrum crashed and retail investors bought both; the hosts warned about catching falling knives. The episode also covers US reports (Tesla, SpaceX, Meta, Spotify) and closes with Affärsvärlden's sell case on Corem, citing rising vacancies, the Kista and Ericsson exposure, weak interest coverage and a bank-dividend trick that flatters the coverage ratio.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 CORE-B — Corem | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Affärsvärlden (cited analyst, Daniel Zetterberg) has a sell recommendation; vacancy 18% and rising, Kista exposure, interest coverage 1.7x (1.4x without bank dividends).

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view. Economic vacancy is among the sector's highest at 18% and will exceed 20% once Ericsson leaves Kista in 2030. Kista office vacancy could pass 50%. Converting to housing is costly and slow. Corem sold about half its properties (SEK 30bn) yet LTV rose and interest coverage fell to 1.7x, below the comfort level of credit assessors. That figure is flattered by about 300m in dividends from a SEK 3bn bank-share portfolio. Writedowns of about 25% may or may not be enough.

#### Sell Triggers

- if vacancy rate starts falling materially
- if Kista conversions or new tenants recover property values
- if interest rates fall sharply, improving interest coverage

> *"Ni ska vara med första gången 22 oktober, den här analysen då. Ni har satt ett sälj. råd på dem?"*

---

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Hosts warn that dip-buying Volvo Cars is catching a falling knife after its first adjusted loss; Alexander avoids the auto industry entirely.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Q3 adjusted EBIT swung to -3.7bn, China volumes fell nearly 50% under Chinese competition and 2,500 jobs are being cut. The stock is down 65% YTD and over 80% since IPO. The hosts say you need a case for why it will turn before buying, warn against buying a product you like without checking the numbers, and call this 'en klassisk fånga fallande kniv'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a credible turnaround plan stabilises China/NA sales
- if margins return to positive adjusted EBIT

> *"Det här är ju en klassisk fånga fallande kniv. Det är oerhört svårt."*
